about_short_description.short_description: TamLabs enhances document workflows with AI-driven editing, formatting, and real-time revision tracking.

identifier.value: TamLabs AI Editor for Microsoft Word

product.name: TamLabs AI Editor for Microsoft Word
product.description: An AI-powered editor integrated within Microsoft Word that allows users to edit documents through natural language chat commands, implementing changes instantly while preserving formatting.

product.name: TamLabs Document Collaboration Features
product.description: Features that enable teams to compare, control, and approve document changes instantly to support collaborative editing and revision tracking.

product.name: TamLabs AI-Powered Formatting Maintenance
product.description: A functionality that ensures document formatting remains intact when AI-driven content edits and suggestions are applied.

product.name: TamLabs Auto Comment Implementation (Coming Soon)
product.description: A planned feature to automatically respond to and implement comments across entire documents to streamline the review process.

product.name: TamLabs Smart Rewrites (Coming Soon)
product.description: A forthcoming feature providing real-time, context-aware suggestions to predict and accelerate the drafting and editing process.

product.name: TamLabs Predictive Navigation Assistance (Coming Soon)
product.description: An upcoming feature that predicts the next document section a user will edit, enabling faster navigation across large files.
